title: Discovery & Research
body: I start with the business, not the brief. Audience, category, competitors, and the one thing this film has to make people feel. You get a short strategic summary before we write a word.

title: Concept & Scriptwriting
body: Three distinct territories, one recommended direction. Then the script: voiceover, dialogue, and visual beats written to be shot — not to sound clever on a page.

title: Storyboarding & Visual Direction
body: Frame-accurate boards, a look book, and test generations. We lock the visual language — palette, lens, texture, pace — before production spend begins.

title: Asset Creation & Production
body: The build. AI generation, practical plates, motion design, and sound assets, produced in parallel and reviewed in daily selects. You see the film taking shape, not just a bill.

title: Editing & Post-Production
body: Story assembly, then rhythm. Colour, sound design, music, titles, and finishing. This is where the film finds its pulse and the commercial idea becomes undeniable.

title: Quality Control & Revisions
body: Frame-by-frame checks, artefact clean-up, continuity, loudness, legibility, and two structured revision rounds. Nothing ships until it holds up on a phone and a cinema screen.

title: Final Delivery
body: Every master you need, correctly encoded and named: broadcast, web, social, vertical, captions, and thumbnails. Plus a tidy handover folder your team can actually use.
